# ConnectBot termlib 0.3.11

Kotlin sources are vendored from the published [0.3.11 sources archive](https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/connectbot/termlib/0.3.11/termlib-0.3.11-sources.jar), SHA-256 `ff3fa41be5dacb4ff250d17a0a16e4e11985d018db1afa1af59fc31bee53b900`. String resources match that version's AAR. Upstream is [connectbot/termlib](https://github.com/connectbot/termlib); the source headers retain their Apache-2.0 copyright notices and LICENSE is included here.

The only source changes expose `ScrollController` and `TerminalWithAccessibility` as public APIs. This gives the app a read-only way to scroll local output and return to live output while keeping the display emulator's keyboard callback empty. The app never accesses hidden Kotlin internals. Local read-mode gestures send no terminal input; explicit program-scroll gestures use the app's separately scoped input queue. Device regressions exercise real native scrollback, selection, fit-width, and alternate-screen history access.

Gradle downloads the official `org.connectbot:termlib:0.3.11@aar` solely to extract its unchanged `libjni_cb_term.so` libraries for all four ABIs. The extraction task verifies the AAR SHA-256 `427dc409194fb9accd8e379254117e85d6f915635c58b1716dbd9d3095d98505`; it does not include upstream's compiled Kotlin classes, so there are no duplicate classes. No NDK or additional native build is required. Review source and binary provenance together when updating this module.

AGP 9.4 / Kotlin 2.4 lint was observed spinning for over nine minutes in `BidirectionalTextDetector` → `KotlinUFile.getAllCommentsInFile` → `PsiWalkingState.walkChildren` while scanning these sources. Only this module's `BidirectionalText` detector is replaced with `verifySourceText`, a mandatory build/lint prerequisite that strictly decodes every Kotlin/XML source as UTF-8 and rejects all bidi embedding, override, isolate, and directional-mark controls. The initial 46 Kotlin files contain none. Other library lint checks and the application's complete lint configuration remain enabled. Re-evaluate this workaround when upgrading AGP/Kotlin.
